title: DroneDeploy Launches Ground Pro, Bringing Measurable 3D Records Into Procore
summary: Ground Pro turns site photos into actionable 3D records using devices field teams already carry, making measurable jobsite conditions accessible in Procore.
body_markdown:
**SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. September 22, 2026 —**[DroneDeploy](https://www.dronedeploy.com/?utm_source=media&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=dd-ground-pro-launch) , the robotics and visual intelligence platform used on over 3 million sites, today announced the general availability of[Ground Pro](https://www.dronedeploy.com/lp/ground-pro?utm_source=media&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=dd-ground-pro-launch) , the advanced 3D capability layer within[DroneDeploy Ground](https://www.dronedeploy.com/product/dronedeploy-ground?utm_source=media&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=dd-ground-pro-launch) built for the superintendents and site managers who run the projects every day.


Construction drawings describe the finished building, but rarely reflect the floor a superintendent is standing on today, where materials are getting staged or where small details disappear behind finishes. DroneDeploy’s Ground Pro gives field teams a current, measurable record of those conditions using mobile devices they already carry. It expands the field from 2D photos to 3D visuals they can capture, measure and share in one unified platform.


The launch follows Procore’s[recently completed acquisition](https://www.procore.com/blog/procore-acquires-dronedeploy-to-bring-visual-intelligence-to-every-jobsite) of DroneDeploy. Integrating DroneDeploy's multi-modal reality capture – spanning drones, ground robots, and cameras – with Procore’s AI-powered construction management platform, site managers can access a richer picture of the jobsite than ever before possible. Ground Pro will make jobsite reality measurable, accessible, and actionable within Procore, advancing construction’s system of intelligence with an unmatched ability to perceive site conditions, reason through them and act on what's next.


Customers like[Steele & Freeman](https://steelefreeman.com/) use Ground Pro to scan work before it gets covered up, so it can answer questions about a job long after the crew has left.


"Ground Pro has changed how we protect a project. We captured a grease trap before it was backfilled, and when the underground plumbing and utilities came into question weeks later, that 3D scan settled the matter in minutes instead of receiving a change order to fix the damage," said Oscar Martyn, Assistant Project Manager at Steele & Freeman. "We can close out a job, get a call a year later about a dimension or questionable installation and answer it without sending anyone back to the site. It has saved us real money and unnecessary trips, and it lets the field team make decisions from what is actually in the ground today rather than a drawing that doesn't reflect reality."


Another leading contractor[KAST Construction](https://www.kastbuild.com/) uses Ground Pro to plan interior work on its mid- and high-rise projects, where a single level can hold several trades at once.


"Drones have given us a high-level view of jobsite progress for years. Ground Pro now gives us that same perspective inside the building," said John McDermott, Senior VDC Manager at KAST. "A 10-minute walk with a 360 camera produces not only a 3D, immersive view of what a floor looks like; but also a 2D map of what's been laid out on the floor and above the ceiling. Instead of clicking through photos one at a time, hoping they're organized well enough to know where and when they were taken, I can now see where material is stacked and which rooms a trade has taken over, all mapped to a floor plan."


"The hardware to capture a 3D record of a jobsite has been in everyone’s phones for years. Ground Pro finally delivers the software to enable every member of the field team to instantly capture the site in accurate 3D," said James Stripe, VP, Product, Reality Capture and Robotics at Procore. "From the 360 walks teams already do, Interior Maps give the whole project team a single-glance view of what is staged on the floor and what is going in overhead, so everyone can sequence work from what is actually on site."


**What is Ground Pro?**


Ground Pro is a premium add-on to DroneDeploy Ground. It turns everyday captures into measurable, verifiable 3D records – whether the work is indoors, outdoors or underground – using the iPhone, iPad or 360 camera field teams already carry. For Procore customers, this 3D data will greatly expand the power of Procore AI.


Ground Pro adds three powerful new capabilities:


-


**Interior Maps** produce a plan view of current floor and ceiling conditions, so teams can sequence trades, review material laydown and confirm overhead work in place, building lookaheads from what is on the floor rather than a plan set that has moved on. For Procore customers, drawings synced with DroneDeploy can be overlaid on the floor and ceiling maps to verify today's site conditions against the design.


-


**Mobile 3D Scan** (with optional RTK) documents trenches, in-slab sleeves and facade patches in the time it takes to snap a photo, fast enough to run before backfill and durable enough to settle a question about buried work months later.


-


**3D Measure & Navigation** reconstructs the 360 walks teams already capture into a navigable, measurable 3D mesh, so a superintendent can verify blocking, door widths and casework clearances after the walls close, and move through atriums and large interiors with a dollhouse view, without sending anyone back to site.


Together, these new capabilities help teams get faster documentation, fewer disputes, and a single clear picture shared from the field to the office.


All three capabilities are shown running on live projects in DroneDeploy’s recent webinar,[Beyond Site Photos: How to see your floors, ceilings and trenches in 3D](https://www.dronedeploy.com/resources/webinars/beyond-site-photos-how-to-see-your-floors-ceilings-and-trenches-in-3d?utm_source=media&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=dd-ground-pro-launch) , now available on demand.


**About DroneDeploy**


DroneDeploy powers field teams with robotics and AI. Used on over 3 million sites in 180 countries, DroneDeploy is the only platform that combines drones, robots, 360 cameras and AI agents to capture and organize site conditions into a single, time-stamped record that teams can trust in the field and office. From construction and energy to infrastructure and agriculture, the world's largest companies use DroneDeploy to document work in place, verify quantities, resolve disputes faster and keep projects on time, on budget and safe. In September 2026, DroneDeploy became part of Procore, advancing construction's system of intelligence that perceives, reasons and acts on the jobsite.


**About Procore**


Procore Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: PCOR) is a leading technology partner for every stage of construction. Built for the industry, Procore’s unified technology platform drives efficiency and mitigates risk through AI & data-driven insights and decision making. Over three million projects have run on Procore across 150+ countries. For more information, visit www.procore.com.
